expect_sql: WITH numbered AS (SELECT p.player_id,g.season_id,p.goals+p.assists AS points,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY p.player_id,g.season_id ORDER BY g.day,g.game_id) AS n FROM game_player_stats p JOIN games g USING(game_id) WHERE g.game_type=2 AND g.season_id BETWEEN 20212022 AND 20242025), starts AS (SELECT player_id,season_id,sum(points) AS start_points FROM numbered WHERE n<=10 GROUP BY player_id,season_id HAVING count(*)=10 AND count(points)=10), ranked AS (SELECT s.*,p.points AS season_points,p.games,row_number() OVER (ORDER BY start_points DESC,s.season_id,s.player_id) AS rank FROM starts s JOIN players_season_stats p USING(player_id,season_id) WHERE p.game_type=2 AND p.games>=40), top AS (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rank<=30) SELECT count(*),count(*) FILTER(WHERE season_points*10<start_points*games),max(start_points) FILTER(WHERE rank=1),max(start_points) FILTER(WHERE rank=2),max(start_points) FILTER(WHERE rank=3) FROM top
